name: Microsoft and Xbox Login
description: Allow users to sign in with their Microsoft or Xbox account
author: uxwVend

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Set up Microsoft OAuth sign-in for your site.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: A single-tenant application also needs AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER set to https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Left unset, sign-in runs against the shared /common/ endpoint, which accepts any Microsoft or Xbox account.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Siteniz için Microsoft ile OAuth girişini yapılandırın.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Tek kiracılı (single-tenant) bir uygulama için ayrıca AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER değişkenini https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0 olarak ayarlayın. Boş bırakılırsa giriş, her Microsoft veya Xbox hesabını kabul eden ortak /common/ uç noktası üzerinden yapılır.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: OAuth-Anmeldung über Microsoft für Ihre Seite einrichten.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Eine Single-Tenant-Anwendung braucht zusätzlich AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER mit https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Ohne diesen Wert läuft die Anmeldung über den gemeinsamen /common/-Endpunkt, der jedes Microsoft- oder Xbox-Konto akzeptiert.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Configura el inicio de sesión OAuth con Microsoft para tu sitio.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Una aplicación de un solo inquilino necesita además AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER con https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Sin ese valor, el acceso usa el extremo compartido /common/, que acepta cualquier cuenta de Microsoft o Xbox.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Configurez la connexion OAuth Microsoft pour votre site.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Une application mono-locataire a aussi besoin de AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER réglée sur https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Sans cette valeur, la connexion passe par le point d'entrée partagé /common/, qui accepte n'importe quel compte Microsoft ou Xbox.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Настройте вход на сайт через Microsoft по OAuth.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Приложению с одним арендатором нужна ещё переменная AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER со значением https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Без неё вход идёт через общий эндпоинт /common/, который принимает любой аккаунт Microsoft или Xbox.

microsoftAuth.adm_subtitle: Configure o início de sessão OAuth com Microsoft no seu site.
microsoftAuth.adm_tenantNote: Uma aplicação de inquilino único precisa ainda de AUTH_MICROSOFT_ENTRA_ID_ISSUER com https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/v2.0. Sem esse valor, o início de sessão usa o ponto partilhado /common/, que aceita qualquer conta Microsoft ou Xbox.
